So the word is iva ("as it were"), not eva ("indeed"), exactly like the four other iva similes in this unit (kṣvelete iva, tudyete iva, pipīlikābhir iva, parikṛntann iva). The flag "tama eva" is therefore wrong and should be dropped; the draft also dropped "eva" from both translations.
